baseline_models.mechanism: Possessors address their own bodily envelopes as separate respondents; adverse testimony, a causative grant of speech, first creation, and return make the created body an evidentiary subject under its maker's jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: The bodily envelope is grammatically detached as an addressed participant and supplies the material witness.
A knowledge-bearing declaration gives forensic force to the phrase 'against us.'
Intelligible articulation makes the skin a respondent, while the doubled causative assigns that faculty to God.
Original bringing-into-being grounds both divine authority over the body and the capability to activate it.
Return closes the movement by bringing embodied owners back under the same jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: The skins miraculously talk during judgment.
changed_reading.after: The created bodily boundary is commissioned as an independent evidentiary subject and returns with its owner to the maker who can articulate it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The universal scope of making every thing speak, together with branches for speaking indication and witness-sign, permits a second layer beneath vocal dialogue: created matter can be rendered legible as evidence.

activation_trace.role: The body's visible covering provides a surface on which embodied history can become legible.
A sign that bears witness widens testimony from a witness's report to an evidentiary mark.
Manifest indication supplies a nonvocal sense of speaking and makes universal articulation materially coherent.
A thing's meaningful indication lets the framing dialogue carry manifested meaning as well as uttered words.
Anything knowable and reportable supplies the unrestricted domain over which evidence can be made articulate.

changed_reading.before: God temporarily gives mute skin a human-like voice.
changed_reading.after: God makes every created surface semantically legible; the vocal exchange dramatizes a broader conversion of material traces into explicit evidence.

baseline_models.mechanism: Beginning, one temporal occurrence, and return form a loop around the speech event. The first maker does not add an alien faculty so much as reconfigure the measured creature during its passage back.

activation_trace.role: Activated articulation is the event whose place in the creation-return sequence must be explained.
Measured formation makes bodily capacity an originally ordered rather than autonomous possession.
Temporal precedence identifies creation as the first activation against which the speaking body is read.
A bounded temporal occurrence makes 'first time' imply a further passage rather than a static origin.
Being brought back completes the loop and locates renewed bodily disclosure within return.

changed_reading.before: First creation is a parenthetical proof that God can make skin speak.
changed_reading.after: The speaking body is a second configured passage of the same measured creature from first formation toward return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first supplies detailed, lucid recitation, then refusal to hear, and finally deliberate noise intended to defeat that recitation. The focus opens an alternative disclosure medium: the hearer's own matter is made to signify and testify, so suppression of the external message cannot suppress evidence.

activation_trace.role: Speaking indication anchors the changed reading in God's conversion of the body into a disclosure channel.
Knowledge-bearing testimony identifies the channel's output as evidence rather than mere sound.
Detailed clarification establishes an ordinarily explicit message whose reception is later contested.
Lucid articulation removes obscurity from the normal verbal disclosure channel.
Auditory perception is the reception faculty explicitly withheld from the clarified message.
Recited discourse is the precise target of the attempted suppression.
Mixed acoustic noise supplies the interference mechanism used against hearing.
Overpowering force names the intended result of controlling the soundscape.

structural_cues: 41:3-4 pairs articulated revelation with refusal to hear; 41:26 turns refusal into the tactic 'do not listen, make noise, prevail.'
The focus repeats causative anṭaqa and extends it to every thing, shifting disclosure from an external recitation to created matter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an accessible recitation, refused hearing, and deliberate acoustic interference; I infer a directional shift to a bodily channel that cannot be jammed. A live alternative is that the recitation conflict and bodily testimony are parallel speech scenes without a causal channel replacement.

changed_reading.before: The skins speak only because a courtroom requires witnesses.
changed_reading.after: The skins are an unjammable disclosure medium: when hearers suppress articulated revelation, God makes their own created matter articulate the evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Early speakers place covers over inward reception, weight in ears, and a barrier between parties. Later concealment fails before hearing, sight, and skins because it rested on a false estimate of divine knowledge. Since skin is itself the body's covering, its speech reverses the claimed protective boundary into an exposing surface.

activation_trace.role: The literal bodily covering anchors the reversal from enclosure to disclosure.
Manifest indication turns the enclosing surface into an outwardly legible one.
Protective covering supplies the earlier model of an inward domain sealed from the message.
Weight in the ear materializes blocked reception at a bodily aperture.
Prevention of access extends enclosure from organs to the relation between speaker and hearer.
Covering and concealment identify the strategy that organ testimony defeats.
Uncertain supposition exposes the faulty epistemic premise behind attempted concealment.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower supplies the divine reach that the covering cannot limit.

structural_cues: 41:5 locates blockage in hearts, ears, and the interval between parties; 41:22 returns to concealment and the hearing-sight-skin triad.
The possessive 'their skins' and adverse 'against us' make the owner's nearest boundary the point at which enclosure reverses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of covers, ear-weight, barrier, attempted concealment, and organ testimony; I infer that the body's covering is causally reversed into disclosure. A live alternative is a simpler contrast between worldly refusal and later judgment with no special boundary mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A body part unexpectedly betrays the person who owns it.
changed_reading.after: The very covering presumed to preserve a hidden interior is inverted into the surface through which that interior becomes public.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sky and earth are addressed and answer in willing compliance during creation; later dead earth moves and rises through renewed life, followed by power over every thing. These scenes make skin-speech one local activation of creation-wide responsiveness to its maker.

activation_trace.role: Bringing creatures into existence is the focus's explicit ground for their renewed responsiveness.
God-given articulation is the bodily instance generalized by the cosmic command-response.
Return makes the later revival scene relevant to the body's reactivated capacities.
Uttered address and reply give the sky-earth relation the same dialogic form as the skin exchange.
Compliance makes cosmic matter responsive rather than merely passive under command.
Earth's life-marking movement supplies a material transition from stillness to activated response.
Life returning to earth provides the surah's concrete reactivation analogy.
Loss of life sets the maximal incapacity that divine reactivation overcomes.
Effective capability over every thing makes the extension from revived earth to speaking skin explicit.

structural_cues: 41:11 places a two-party command and answer inside the first-creation sequence.
41:39 repeats 'every thing' after dead-earth revival, echoing the focus's 'made every thing speak.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speaking, compliant cosmos and a visibly reactivated earth; I infer an ontology of creaturely responsiveness connecting those scenes to the skins. A live alternative is that 41:11 is rhetorical personification and 41:39 only an analogy for resurrection power.

changed_reading.before: Speaking skin is an isolated suspension of ordinary material incapacity.
changed_reading.after: Speaking skin is a concentrated instance of a surah-wide rule: creation can answer, move, and disclose when its maker activates it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate frame ties organ testimony to what people did; later recompense answers action, and the closing rule sends good to the self and evil against it while denying misplacement by the Lord. Bodily testimony is therefore the person's own action returning through the self's created substrate.

activation_trace.role: The owner's own bodily envelope keeps the evidence within the embodied self rather than importing an alien accuser.
Adverse knowledgeable testimony is the mechanism by which action becomes judicially reflexive.
Return supplies the directional movement by which embodied action comes back upon its agent.
Intentional deed is explicitly named as the content and cause of the organs' testimony.
Answering an act with its consequence supplies the judicial return relation.
Deliberate action is grammatically routed toward its own agent.
The thing's own self supplies the endpoint for both benefit and adverse consequence.
Harmful action supplies the negative content that returns against the self.
Putting something in a wrong place marks the injustice excluded when one's own action returns through one's own body.

structural_cues: 41:20 says the organs testify because of what their owners were doing; 41:21 then asks why the testimony is 'against us.'
41:46 balances 'for his self' with 'against it' and immediately denies injustice by the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed-based testimony, act-matched recompense, and action routed for or against the self; I infer that embodied evidence preserves and returns the agent's own deed. A live alternative is purely legal accountability with no claim that the body materially retains action.

changed_reading.before: The body betrays its owner by joining an external prosecution.
changed_reading.after: The owner's deed returns as evidence through the owner's own embodied self, making judgment reflexive rather than an alien accusation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned supposition is that God does not know much of what they do, while the close declares God witness over every thing and completely encompassing every thing. Causing things to speak does not acquire missing information; it externalizes already encompassing knowledge into an undeniable public form.

activation_trace.role: Manifest indication is the operation that publicizes knowledge rather than producing it for God.
Knowledge-bearing declaration supplies the public evidentiary form.
Mistaken conjecture identifies the false model of limited divine access that the speaking body corrects.
Knowledge as the thing's disclosure to the knower names the capacity wrongly denied.
Witnessing over every thing generalizes the focus's local body-witness relation to divine knowledge.
Total inclusion gives the closing witness formula the same unrestricted scope as the focus.
Every knowable and reportable thing is already within the domain of divine witnessing.
Complete epistemic enclosure removes any informational gap that creaturely speech would need to fill.

structural_cues: 41:22 explicitly locates the failure in what they supposed God knew; 41:23 says that supposition destroyed them.
41:53-54 close with witness and encompassing formulas over every thing, repeating the focus's universal object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false conjecture about divine knowledge followed by total witness and encompassment; I infer that creaturely testimony manifests knowledge for judgment rather than informs God. A live alternative is that testimony remains a formal judicial procedure whose epistemic purpose is left unstated.

changed_reading.before: God calls bodily witnesses to establish facts that require testimony.
changed_reading.after: God makes already encompassed facts publicly undeniable, correcting the deeper error that hidden deeds escaped divine knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing promise sets signs in distant horizons beside signs within selves until truth becomes manifest, then names God witness over every thing. The focus supplies a concrete inner sign: the body's visible boundary is made explicitly indicative and testifies.

activation_trace.role: The bodily covering gives the inner-sign system a concrete, visible surface within the person's own embodied self.
Speaking indication converts a latent bodily sign into explicit meaning.
Caused showing supplies the disclosure process by which signs become perceptible.
An evident sign names the category into which the speaking skin is newly placed.
Distant horizons provide the outer pole against which evidence within the self gains force.
The self as the thing itself locates the relevant signs inside rather than among foreign witnesses.
Emergence into clarity supplies the endpoint of the body's move from silent sign to testimony.
Truth fixed to reality is what the inward bodily sign discloses.
A witness-sign over every thing fuses the closing sign vocabulary with the focus's bodily witness.

structural_cues: 41:53 balances 'in the horizons' with 'in themselves' and gives both a single result: truth becomes clear.
Its final 'over every thing a witness' recombines the focus's roots for every thing and testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer and inner signs that are progressively shown until truth is clear; I infer that the speaking skin is a concrete enactment of the inner-sign pole. A live alternative is that 41:53 promises general proofs and does not classify organ testimony as one of them.

changed_reading.before: The skin is a hostile informant standing over against the person.
changed_reading.after: The skin is also the nearest inward sign: evidence already within the self is made explicit until the truth cannot remain latent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers botanic and gestational emergence into a testimony scene. It remains anchored in skin as bodily covering and in causative indication, while 41:47 sequences covered fruit, hidden carrying, delivery, knowledge, and witness. Render it only as a material analogy for emergence across a boundary, not as lexical equivalence or a reproductive interpretation of the focus.

activation_trace.role: The bodily covering supplies the boundary across which concealed evidence becomes manifest.
Causative indication supplies the transition from latent content to explicit evidence.
Knowledge already reaches both hidden process and outward event, framing emergence as disclosure rather than discovery.
Movement out of concealment supplies the directional transition assigned to testimony.
A plant's enclosing sheath supplies a material analogue for the skin-bound hidden interior.
Interior carrying supplies a model of content retained before outward manifestation.
Delivery supplies the terminal crossing from enclosed content into the public field.
The explicit absence of a knowledgeable witness at the scene keeps the material emergence tied to testimony.

changed_reading.before: The skin reports facts that were somehow stored in it.
changed_reading.after: Testimony can be imagined as an emergence event: what was carried behind a covering crosses its boundary into public evidence under knowledge that already enclosed it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's form-distant q-w-l to q-l-l split and is therefore deliberately strange. It remains anchored in the two focus occurrences of q-w-l and in the shift of speaking control from owners to skins, with 41:39 supplying an actual movement image. Render it only as a formal or affective resonance of destabilized discourse; do not translate qāla as 'tremble' or claim a direct lexical sense.

activation_trace.role: A fear-like tremor supplies an affective undertone to the owners' challenged control of the dialogue.
Instability and movement model the transfer of speaking authority from human questioners to bodily respondents.
God-enabled articulation is the force that destabilizes the owners' monopoly on speech.
Actual shaking and movement elsewhere in the surah gives the formal instability a contained material echo.

changed_reading.before: The two uses of 'they said' neutrally frame a question and answer.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory formal level, the dialogue itself loses stability as human speech is displaced by God-enabled counter-speech from the body.

strongest_changes: The skin's ordinary covering function is reversed: blocked and concealed reception becomes involuntary bodily disclosure.
Cosmic command-response and dead-earth revival recast skin-speech as creation-wide responsiveness under the first Creator.
Action for or against the self and total divine knowledge recast testimony as reflexive public manifestation, not information supplied to God.
The closing signs within selves make the speaking skin an inward sign whose latent evidence becomes explicit.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context connected the focus not only to judgment but to a sustained conflict over disclosure media: detailed recitation, refused hearing, deliberate noise, bodily witness, inner signs, and total encompassment.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether anṭaqa should be rendered as audible speech alone or can also carry nonvocal material indication.
Whether cosmic address and revived earth imply a direct ontology of responsive matter or function only as analogies for divine power.
The sheath-emergence and q-w-l/q-l-l readings remain exploratory material and formal resonances.
